Hex 1428: Hept-Secundus UWP: C5867FA-B | Allegiance: He Bases: Military Secondary Worlds: 8 (Gas Giants: 3, Belts: 0) Trade Codes: Ag History: Epoch V (1092) (Heptamorphoid Hivemind Expansion) Lore: Western brood-cluster of the Heptarchy of Septima; launches spore-cruiser strikes against Avalar's Rocaroja (1432) naval base.

Hex 1528: Chitin-Reach UWP: B7978FB-C | Allegiance: He Bases: Naval Secondary Worlds: 17 (Gas Giants: 4, Belts: 3) Trade Codes: Ht History: Epoch V (1088) (Heptamorphoid Hivemind Expansion) Lore: Primary orbital gestation yard for the Heptamorphoid Hivemind's heptagonal bioships.

Hex 1628: Septima Prime UWP: B6A69FB-C | Allegiance: He Bases: Naval Secondary Worlds: 10 (Gas Giants: 4, Belts: 2) Trade Codes: Fl, Hi, Ht, In History: Epoch I (Native Sophont Homeworld) (Heptamorphoid Hivemind Nexus) Lore: Homeworld of the Heptamorphs (Khept-7): a 7-fold radially symmetric biological/psionic hivemind native to a dense exotic atmosphere (SCG 1628). Since 1104, Septima Prime has waged the Septiman War against the Avalar Consulate (Lun Escarpa 1630).
